**Finding submitted: INDEMN — missing (critical), preferred level.**

- **Investigation:** Searched the full document for "indemn", "hold harmless / defend", "infringe intellectual property", and "liability / damages / limitation" — all returned nothing. Read both substantive sections in full (§§1.4–5.3 and §§5.4–10.8). The only IP-adjacent text is the advertising covenant at p0046 (content must not be "infringing of third party intellectual property rights"), which is a mutual covenant, not an indemnity. There is also no limitation-of-liability clause.
- **Result:** No Vendor indemnity of any kind — walk-away territory.
- **Cure:** One insert of a new Section 9A after the warranty section (p0058), before General Provisions: HDI defends and indemnifies the Company and its affiliates for third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Services/Site, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused unauthorized access to Company data, and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct; notice, control of defence and reasonable cooperation procedure; and the Company's reciprocal indemnity confined to the Content we supply and our own breach of law. I chose preferred over fallback because fallback would import a 3× annual-fees super-cap on HDI's liability (no annual fee construct exists here — payments are Net-Sales based) and would weaken our position.
